decisive_spans.text: CT chest: demonstrated a cavitary lung lesion in the right base, later showing diffuse tree-in-bud pattern infiltrates

response.rationale: D5 (Invasive Aspergillosis) is strongly supported by multiple specific findings including positive Aspergillus in BAL, elevated 1-3-β-D-glucan, and characteristic CT chest findings. While D10 (Strongyloidiasis) is also supported by direct evidence, the combination of findings for D5 is more comprehensive and indicative of a severe invasive fungal infection.
